entries.claim: The CMB scalar spectral index n_s is predicted from the braided winding geometry.
entries.falsification: n_s outside [0.96, 0.97] at ≥2σ in any future CMB survey falsifies the winding inflation prediction.
entries.timeline: Current data: PASS. CMB-S4 will sharpen to σ(n_s) ~ 0.002.

entries.claim: The tensor-to-scalar ratio r is suppressed by the braided sound speed c_s = 12/37.
entries.falsification: r > 0.036 at 95% CL in future data falsifies the braided suppression mechanism.
entries.timeline: Current data: PASS. CMB-S4 will reach σ(r) ~ 0.002.

entries.claim: Cosmic birefringence β is predicted at two canonical branches from the braided CS coupling.
entries.falsification: Any β outside [0.22°, 0.38°] at ≥2σ, or β inside the predicted gap [0.29°, 0.31°], falsifies the braided winding mechanism. This is the primary falsifier.
entries.timeline: LiteBIRD 2032: σ(β) ≈ 0.03°. Decisive test expected 2032–2034.

entries.claim: The winding number n_w = 5 is the unique integer consistent with all three CMB constraints simultaneously.
entries.prediction: n_w = 5; stability margin Δn_w = 1 (n_w=4 and n_w=6 excluded)
entries.falsification: Any β outside [0.22°, 0.38°] would remove n_w=5 from the admissible set. Equivalently, n_s outside [0.9607, 0.9691] at ≥2σ.
entries.timeline: LiteBIRD 2032 is the primary timeline for testing the n_w=5 selection.

entries.claim: The Higgs mass is consistent with one-loop KK corrections to the 5D Higgs potential.
entries.falsification: m_H outside [120, 132] GeV from a complete 5D two-loop calculation would require revising the Higgs sector architecture.
entries.timeline: HL-LHC will measure Higgs couplings to <1% precision by 2035.

entries.claim: Normal Hierarchy (NH) is preferred over Inverted Hierarchy (IH) by the Z₂ Dirichlet orbifold boundary conditions.
entries.prediction: NH: m₁≈0, m₂≈8.6 meV, m₃≈50.9 meV; Σmν≈0.0596 eV
entries.measurement: NuFIT 5.3: NH preferred at >3σ (current global fit)
entries.falsification: IH confirmed at ≥5σ by JUNO or equivalent would falsify the Z₂ Dirichlet BC selection.
entries.timeline: JUNO neutrino ordering measurement expected 2027-2030.

entries.claim: The absolute neutrino mass scale Σmν ≈ 0.0596 eV is predicted from the KK compactification.
entries.falsification: Σmν > 0.12 eV at ≥2σ from cosmological data would tension the NH prediction.
entries.timeline: DESI Year 3 and Euclid expected to reach σ(Σmν) ~ 0.02 eV.

entries.claim: The lightest KK excitation of the 5D metric is a dark matter candidate with M_KK ≈ 1 TeV.
entries.uncertainty: M_KK ∈ [0.8, 1.3] TeV; σ_SI at tree level only
entries.measurement: XENON-nT: not yet excluded at 1 TeV (σ_SI limit ≈ 8×10⁻⁴⁷ cm²)
entries.falsification: Direct detection of KK DM with M_KK outside [0.8, 1.3] TeV, or σ_SI > 10⁻⁴⁵ cm², would strongly tension this candidate.
entries.timeline: XENON-nT 1-tonne-year result expected 2026. HL-LHC KK graviton searches by 2030.

entries.claim: The solar neutrino mass splitting Δm²₂₁ is derived from the KK spectrum with 1.07σ residual.
entries.falsification: If residual tension grows to ≥3σ after NLO corrections are included, the KK Δm²₂₁ prediction would need revision.
entries.timeline: JUNO expected to measure Δm²₂₁ to <0.5% precision by 2027.

entries.claim: The PMNS solar mixing angle sin²θ₁₂ is geometrically derived from the FN charge n_FN=1.
entries.falsification: sin²θ₁₂ outside [0.27, 0.34] at ≥3σ would require revising the FN charge assignment.
entries.timeline: Current data: PASS. JUNO and HyperK will sharpen this by 2030.

entries.claim: CKM matrix elements are derived from SVD of the 5D Yukawa texture.
entries.prediction: CKM elements from 5D SVD; Jarlskog invariant J_CKM from geometry
entries.uncertainty: FN charges partially constrained (3 irreducible free params remain)
entries.measurement: PDG CKM: consistent at current precision
entries.falsification: Any CP-violating observable outside the geometric CKM prediction at ≥3σ.
entries.timeline: Belle II and LHCb Run-3 will probe CKM unitarity to new precision by 2028.

entries.claim: The CMB acoustic peak amplitude is suppressed by ×4–7 relative to Planck data.
entries.prediction: A_s mismatch: 33.6% residual (Silk damping + KK truncation bound ≤1.35%)
entries.uncertainty: Residual is architecture limit: NP-BC corrections not yet complete
entries.falsification: This is an acknowledged gap (FALLIBILITY.md Admission 2). Resolution requires completing the NP-BC ladder beyond current scope.
entries.timeline: Open problem. No imminent timeline for closure.

entries.claim: Dark energy equation of state is w₀ = -1, w_a = 0 (cosmological constant) from the KK radion.
entries.falsification: w_a ≠ 0 confirmed at ≥5σ by DESI Year 3 or Euclid would falsify the KK radion dark energy prediction.
entries.timeline: DESI Year 3 expected 2026. Current 2.07σ tension is tracked in CLAIM_MASTER_BOARD.md.

entries.claim: The strong coupling constant α_s is predicted from the 5D KK gauge reduction.
entries.prediction: All four routes (A-D) give < 1% of α_s; gap certified at NNLO
entries.uncertainty: Architecture limit: non-perturbative physics not captured
entries.falsification: Not directly falsifiable at current scope. Architecture limit acknowledged in FALLIBILITY.md.
entries.timeline: Open problem. No imminent timeline.

entries.claim: φ-enhanced nuclear tunneling predicts anomalous excess heat in Pd-D systems (COP > 1).
entries.prediction: COP > 1.0 in Pd-D lattice with φ-enhancement
entries.uncertainty: Lattice phonon model; not a hardgate claim
entries.measurement: No confirmed replication at required precision
entries.falsification: COP ≤ 1.0 in controlled Pd-D experiment with φ-enhancement geometry.
entries.timeline: Laboratory-scale experiment. No community timeline set.

entries.claim: A coupled brain-universe attractor describes consciousness as a φ-resonance phenomenon.
entries.uncertainty: High — no direct experimental test proposed
entries.falsification: No pre-registered falsification condition at current scope.
entries.timeline: Speculative. No imminent experimental timeline.

entries.claim: Froggatt-Nielsen charges are constrained by SVD from 9 to 3 irreducible free parameters.
entries.prediction: 9 → 3 free FN parameters (irreducible geometric lower bound)
entries.measurement: CKM and PMNS phenomenology consistent at current precision
entries.falsification: Demonstrating FN charges have more than 3 free parameters from first principles would require revising the SVD architecture.
entries.timeline: Ongoing. Full closure requires completing the Yukawa sector.

entries.claim: The (5,7) braid pair is the unique survivor of all admissible braid pairs satisfying Axioms Z2 and SW.
entries.prediction: Only (5,7) satisfies Z2 parity + Swampland bound + CMB constraints
entries.uncertainty: Conditional on Axioms Z2 and SW
entries.measurement: Self-consistency check: exhaustive scan of admissible pairs complete
entries.falsification: Any admissible braid pair other than (5,7) surviving all constraints would refute uniqueness.
entries.timeline: LiteBIRD 2032 tests the (5,7) birefringence prediction.

entries.claim: SU(5) unification emerges from the orbifold Weyl parity acting on the 5D gauge group.
entries.prediction: SU(5) ⊃ SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1) from orbifold BC; proton decay rate predicted
entries.measurement: No proton decay observed; current limit τ_p > 10³⁴ yr (consistent)
entries.falsification: Proton decay below τ_p = 10³⁴ yr in p→e⁺π⁰ channel.
entries.timeline: Hyper-Kamiokande will probe τ_p to 10³⁵ yr in the 2030s.

entries.claim: The DESI w_a tension is the highest-priority falsification risk for the framework.
entries.measurement: DESI Year 2 (2025): 2.07σ tension with KK radion prediction
entries.falsification: w_a ≠ 0 at ≥5σ from combined DESI+Euclid+Rubin.
entries.timeline: DESI Year 3 result expected 2026. Watch list: HIGH PRIORITY.

experiments.name: LiteBIRD
experiments.description: CMB polarization satellite. Primary test of birefringence β.

experiments.name: DESI Year 3
experiments.description: Baryon acoustic oscillation survey. Tests dark energy equation of state.

experiments.name: JUNO
experiments.description: Neutrino oscillation reactor experiment. Tests ordering and Δm²₂₁.

experiments.name: XENON-nT
experiments.description: Direct dark matter search. Tests KK DM candidate.
experiments.verdict_threshold: σ_SI > 10⁻⁴⁵ cm² at 1 TeV → strongly tensions KK DM

experiments.name: HL-LHC Run-4
experiments.description: High-luminosity LHC. Tests KK graviton/radion resonances and Higgs couplings.
experiments.verdict_threshold: KK resonance excluded above 3 TeV → tensions DM prediction

experiments.name: nEDM@SNS
experiments.description: Neutron electric dipole moment. Tests CP violation from 5D sector.
experiments.verdict_threshold: d_n > 10⁻²⁶ e·cm at ≥3σ → new CP source beyond KK prediction

experiments.name: Euclid
experiments.description: Space telescope. Tests neutrino masses and dark energy.
experiments.verdict_threshold: Σmν > 0.12 eV at ≥2σ, or w_a ≠ 0 at ≥5σ → FALSIFIED

gate_descriptions.DERIVED: Prediction follows from the 5D geometry with no free parameters introduced.
gate_descriptions.FITTED: Parameter fixed by matching to one experimental input; predictions for others.
gate_descriptions.ARCHITECTURE_LIMIT: Current derivation scope cannot close this gap; acknowledged in FALLIBILITY.md.
gate_descriptions.ADJACENT_TRACK: Exploratory application of UM geometry; not a hardgate physics claim.
